Mark, saw Zuddl is doubling down as the modular platform for large-scale B2B events going into 2026.

Going up-market into bigger events usually means more enterprise organizers worth reaching than the team can cover before they go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Zuddl off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Zuddl needs to close that gap this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
